## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks before the fan (B_1–B_2 only)
Raw TSV traces precede the frequency analysis below. Run 6 at n_A=+3.2e12 cm^-2, D_A≈0 has candidate peaks near 7.3, 14.8, 22.3 and 29.4 T; the near-integer pattern is a harmonic/partition ambiguity, not a stacking verdict. Run 7 at n_A=−1.2e12 has several low-frequency candidates with cutoff-sensitive separation; the gate box cannot reach the |n|≥2–3e12 hole regime preferred by the model.

The helper's default electron onset is **censored at 0.30 T**, and that low-field record is undersampled: 50 mT steps below 1 T fail the F_L=33.1 T Nyquist criterion below about 1.8 T. The 10 mT segment is valid from 1 T; restricting to it still gives a censored carrying tone. Thus the default 0.30 T onset cannot justify a long fan. Frequencies below the valid sampling floor are exploratory only. Both sweeps retain stable drain current (9.81–9.94 nA), sample temperature 1.165–1.292 K, and |gate current|<0.22 nA; no voltage-channel rail (R maxima 530 and 587 ohm against 5 kohm full scale).

The fresh run-5 calibration is ratio-calibrated (c_bg/c_tg=0.7728), absolute-scale geometry-prior, D_offset=−0.013 V/nm from CNP-resistance symmetry. Two ridges in this one contact pair mean that A/B are provisional electrostatic populations, not separately contacted regions; a second population may have a different density offset and D. No independent stacking assignment is warranted yet. A fan should target the electron design-density window and reproduce run 6 at n_A=3.2 before using branch trajectories to resolve the peak-set ambiguity.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency
for rid, n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:
 r=open_run(f'data/{rid}'); fig=plot_raw(r); fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot{rid}_raw.png'); plt.show()
 ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
 I=r.col(ch['sr0'].col)/ch['sr0'].gain
 R=r.col(ch['sr1'].col)/ch['sr1'].gain/I
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); order=np.argsort(B); B,R=B[order],R[order]
 print(f'run {rid}: R {R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} Ohm, I {I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA, T {r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K; duration {(r.meta["end_time"]-r.meta["start_time"])/60:.2f} min')
 for c in ['k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']: print(c,np.percentile(r.col(c)*1e12,[0,50,100]))
 on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000); print(on.summary())
 fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
 for t in on.tones: ax[0].plot(t.b_centers,t.snr,label=f'{t.freq:.1f} T')
 ax[0].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':'); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Matched filter SNR'); ax[0].legend()
 for lo in [on.onset_b,1.5,2,2.5]:
  for degree in [3,5]:
   if lo>=10: continue
   f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),bg_degree=degree,log=False,nfft=4096)
   p,_=find_peaks(sp[0]); p=sorted([p for p in p if 3<f[p]<60],key=lambda p:-sp[0,p])[:5]
   print('FFT',rid,lo,degree,[(round(f[j],2),round(sp[0,j],2)) for j in p])
   ax[1].plot(f,sp[0]/sp[0].max(),label=f'B>{lo:.2f},deg{degree}')
 ax[1].axvline(float(luttinger_frequency(n*1e16)),color='k',ls=':'); ax[1].set(xlim=(0,60),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT'); ax[1].legend(fontsize=7)
 fig.suptitle(f'Run {rid}: n={n}e12, D=0 (run-5 calibration), B_1-B_2'); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot{rid}_fft.png'); plt.show()

## HERA — resolve the censored onset before pricing the Landau fan

> **05:21** · SdH onset extension: n\_A=+3.2e12, D\_A=0; B .35→2 T, 283 inverse-field points; base T, Si 0, 50 uV · **ETA ~05:56** (≈35 min)

`landau-fan` step 1 requires a low-field extension when `sdh_onset` is censored. Run 6 (measure cell 40; analysis cells 14–15) returns a censored 7.3 T candidate at the valid 1 T record edge; its coarse sub-1-T grid cannot establish the onset. Repeat the same n_A=+3.2e12, D_A=0 gate point on a uniform-1/B grid, also supplying the grid-change check from `sdh-spot-check`; the fan follows after this read, on the electron side where the gate box reaches the model's design density.

F_L=33.09 T; including a 20% scale allowance, 283 points give Δ(1/B)=0.00836 T^-1, three samples/period at 39.70 T. This uses uniform 1/B deliberately: the 3.1 s fixed overhead inferred from run 6 (7.46 s minus the 4.38 s 10-mT ramp) makes a uniformly fine B extension unnecessarily expensive; a .35–2 T uniform-B grid at equivalent resolution would require ~1610 points. The unchanged 3 s magnet dwell clears 10τ for τ=.3 s/24 dB; 50 µV stays fixed to reproduce run 6, whose full-range maximum was 530 ohm versus 5 kohm full scale.

Field starts at the operator-restored zero: 0→2 T costs 14.6 min at 1/7.3 T/min, plus 283×3.1 s≈14.6 min and gate positioning; budget 35 min. First checkpoint after 10 points checks all acquired channels, leakage, rail, and thermometry; repeat halfway and at completion. Guard trips stop the sweep; the VTI supply completes any already-issued field move, so an emergency ramp stop is operator action at the supply. Leave B=2 T for the fan design; no return traverse. A still-censored or untrackable extension is a result to report, not a fabricated onset.

# Read-only preconditions before any instrument write.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
from hera.analysis import field_invB
for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts,_Tv,_B,_Si = T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field(),k_si()
print('Expected base T 1.0..1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K, B=0 +/-0.02 T, Si=0; actual:',_Ts,_Tv,_B,_Si)
assert 1.0<=_Ts<=1.5 and _Tv<1.6 and abs(_B)<0.02 and abs(_Si)<0.01
print('Expected heaters off, magnet output/PS on:',heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range(),magnet.output_enabled(),magnet.persistent_switch_on())
assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0
assert magnet.output_enabled() and magnet.persistent_switch_on()
for _p,_limits in [(k_tg.volt,(-.3,1.)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.)),(dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),(magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    _actual=(float(_p.vals._min_value),float(_p.vals._max_value)); print(_p.full_name,'expected',_limits,'actual',_actual); assert _actual==_limits
print('Expected drive 1 V / 13.777 Hz; tau .3 s / slope 24; NPLC 1:',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant(),sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope(),k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.01
assert sr0.time_constant()==.3 and sr1.time_constant()==.3 and sr0.filter_slope()==24 and sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
_vt,_vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
B_vec=field_invB(.35,2.,283)
for _p,_v in [(k_tg.volt,_vt),(k_bg.volt,_vb)]: _p.validate(float(_v))
for _b in B_vec: magnet.field.validate(float(_b))
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)))<=1/(3*1.2*33.086)
assert magnet.settle_s>=3
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
mc=dict(meas_config); mc.update({'comments':'onset extension; n_A=+3.2e12 D_A=0; B .35->2 T, 283 uniform-1/B points; run-6 anchor; 50 uV; 3 s magnet settle','Si (V)':_Si,'sample_temperature:':_Ts})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc); s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check'); s.add_comment(mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(_vb)); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(_vt)); interruptible_sleep(10)
s.fp(T_sample).fp(T_vaporizer).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
for _p in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P): s.plot(magnet.field,_p)
# time,B,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,Ix,Ip,Vx,Vp
_check_time=[0.]
def _extension_guard(station,data):
    if abs(float(data[4]))>1e-9 or abs(float(data[5]))>1e-9 or not 1.0<=float(data[2])<=1.5 or float(data[3])>=1.6:
        print('STOP: leakage/temperature',data); station.interrupt_requested=True
    if abs(float(data[8]))>=.9*50e-6 or abs(float(data[6]))>=.9*sr0.sensitivity():
        print('STOP: headroom'); station.interrupt_requested=True
    if _time.monotonic()-_check_time[0]>60:
        for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'): assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        _check_time[0]=_time.monotonic()
s.register_run_after(_extension_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('Extension endpoint B,TG,BG:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())

s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)

        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())
